title: Explainable AI and Quantum Chemical Exploration of 2D Titanium Carbide MXene (Ti3C2Tx) Nanocarriers for Glioblastoma Therapeutics
description: Fully reproducible computational pipeline and data archive for the study of pristine oxygen-terminated Ti3C2O2 MXene as a delivery scaffold for glioblastoma therapeutics. Includes: GFN2-xTB single-point interaction energies for 35 drugs on the pristine MXene cluster, a rigorous relaxed-complex energetics subset, a single seeded AutoDock Vina v1.2.7 docking run of the 33 dockable compounds against the human EGFR kinase domain (PDB 4ZAU, 2J6M as secondary control) written directly into the master table, a leak-free nested 5x5 cross-validated RidgeCV surrogate with OECD Principle 3 applicability domain, and an end-to-end master script (run_entire_gbm_study.py). Every value in the manuscript is computed from this pipeline; no descriptor or energy is estimated from an empirical formula. v2.0.0 repoints docking from 4UV7 to the manuscript's 4ZAU receptor, seeds all stochastic steps, and hardens the quantum-chemistry step against timeouts.
